name: ztimed_task_tick_active_draw_task_list
description: zTimedTask::TickActiveList walks the active draw-task list, runs eligible immediate tasks, clears one-shot flags, decrements timed tasks, and removes expired tasks.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja reports an LLIL flag-generation limitation at the x87 fstp/store used before the remaining-seconds comparison; assembly and smoke coverage establish the intended countdown behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL at 0x4bd660 shows active-list iteration, immediate dispatch when flag bit 0x02 is clear, one-shot dispatch and clearing for bits 0x04 and 0x08, timed countdown for bit 0x01 using g_FrameDeltaTimeSec, setting expired tasks to kind 9, and removing expired tasks from the active list.
The native timed-task smoke verifies an expiring task is decremented, marked kind 9, and removed from the head while subsequent one-shot 0x04 and 0x08 tasks have those bits cleared and remain active.
